from flask import Flask, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)


@app.post("/login")
def login():
    user = lookup_user()
    if user is None:
        return jsonify(error="user not found"), 401
    if not verify_password(user):
        return jsonify(error="incorrect password"), 401
    return jsonify(ok=True)
